# Copilot instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` before making changes. Before editing SQL, Python, Databricks, or infrastructure files, read the matching file in `.claude/rules/`.

- Do not commit, push, open or merge pull requests, tag, delete branches, deploy, or run destructive or live-database operations unless the user explicitly asks.
- Report what was and was not verified, including whether a live environment was used. Never repeat a discovered secret.
